card.name: Opening phrases of web article intros
card.fires_on: Words inside conversational lead-in phrases near the start of general web articles, such as 'you may be thinking', 'comes to mind', 'think of', 'it's not unusual to', 'these days, when'. It is not about drug labels.

modes.label: Thinking and mind phrases
modes.description: Verbs or nouns of thought in a lead-in addressed to the reader.
modes.example: you may be<< thinking>> of giving one of your kidneys to help

modes.label: Stock intro phrases
modes.description: Words in set openers like 'when it comes to' or 'time of year'.
modes.example: These days,<< when>> it comes to produce, the buzz words

modes.label: Heard or think hooks
modes.description: Verbs such as heard or think after 'you've probably' or 'you might'.
modes.example: You’ve probably<< heard>> the horror stories from Pennsylvania, Wyoming,
